name: DijkstraPathfinder
src_typeComment: Shortest-path search over a GraphNode network (not a grid — see GridPathfinder for that). The result is a plain List<GraphNode>; since GraphNode is a MonoBehaviour, feed its .transform values straight into the existing Toolkit.Mechanics.WaypointPatrol.SetWaypoints() to actually move something along it — no separate "graph path follower" component needed.

src_members.sig: public static List<GraphNode> FindPath(GraphNode start, GraphNode goal)
src_members.name: FindPath
src_members.comment: Returns null if goal is unreachable from start.
